answer_1.quote: The goal of dialogue response generation is to continue a dialogue u T 1 := (u 1 , . . . , u T ) of T turns by generating a new turn u T +1 .

answer_2.quote: To evaluate faithfulness, we employ the hallucination critic introduced by Dziri et al. (2022a) , which classifies responses as hallucinated or not, Q  , which uses a question generation and question answering pipeline, as well as token-level F1 and BERTScore  2 . To measure abstractiveness, we again use Density .

answer_4.quote: In addition to the automatic evaluation, we conduct a human evaluation on WoW and DSTC9 with the help of three expert annotators , using the Attributable to Identified Source (AIS) framework .
answer_4.guideline: We ask them to score responses as attributable (A) only if all their content can be attributed to the knowledge that grounds the dialogue response. Furthermore, we ask annotators to rate cooperativeness (C), i.e. the ability of the model to connect with and follow up on user turns on a 3-point Likert scale. Lastly, annotators rate paraphrasing (P) on a binary scale, where 2 indicates non-trivial paraphrasing of the knowledge and 1 substantial copying.
